Guyana's SNA 2010 methodology names GRDB (rice) and GUYSUCO (sugar, via NES) as data suppliers, but neither is an existing/mintable corpus node (administrative/company data suppliers, not report publications).
SNA 2010: gross output of bauxite is volume times export prices, value added derived from data supplied by 'the industry' — too generic to map to a node.
education.gov.gy page has no citation of enrollment/eligibility data source; no census/Bureau of Statistics linkage found.

Bank of Guyana Quarterly Bulletin and Annual Report 2023 contain no source attribution for BOP figures; only a bare, unversioned mention that BPM6 methodology 'will be used in the future' — generic standard, excluded per standing policy.

Acknowledges CARICOM Secretariat/UN technical assistance and administrative birth/death/migration registers, none of which are existing corpus nodes. As the foundational instrument, no further upstream dependency is expected.

Public Debt Annual Report 2020 cites Bank of Guyana only for a narrow Treasury Bill discount-rate table (no matching node) and IMF WEO for global context; no explicit GDP-source citation found for debt-to-GDP calculations.

Ministry of Education homepage links to a 'Digest of Education Statistics,' which would plausibly cite an Annual School Census, but the site's Joomla folder-based navigation prevented reaching an actual digest PDF to confirm a methodology statement.
No FDI-specific source citation found on Bank of Guyana or Bureau of Statistics sites; only generic, unversioned BPM6 mentions (excluded per standing policy).
petroleum.gov.gy data-chart pages carry no data-source attribution; the GYEITI 2023 report discusses field-level production (sourced 'BoG') but does not name FPSO vessels specifically.

The strong candidate edge (census breaks out Georgetown population: 125,683 persons, 55.66% of combined township population) is blocked because gy-georgetown's own part_of is already gy-census — an edge to its own container. No alternative source found.
mopw.gov.gy projects page names only an 'IDB Funded Loan' project title with no cited funding report; IDB is not a corpus node.

CPI basket is explicitly sourced to a Household Budget Survey (HBS 2006, rebased against HBS 2018/19), but HBS is not an existing corpus node, and the only other methodology reference (COICOP) is a bare/unversioned standard, excluded per standing policy.
Both lcregister.petroleum.gov.gy pages checked (Act page and register homepage) cite no data source at all.
The Rebasing Exercise Report (Base Year 2012) cites only generic/unversioned international standards ('2008 SNA,' 'ISIC Rev 4') with no Guyana-specific report target.
The designated page's own citation is 'Source: Maternal and Child Health Unit and Statistical Unit, Ministry of Health' — Ministry of Health is not an existing corpus node.
education.gov.gy distribution-unit page states only which schools/grades are targeted; no enrollment/needs-assessment data source cited.
Both the CHPA application-form page and CHPA homepage present unsourced figures (e.g. '53,000+ lots allocated') with no citation to census or Bureau of Statistics housing data.
